For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
O make a glad noise with your hands, all you peoples; letting your voices go up to God with joy.
（可拉後裔的詩，交與伶長。）萬民哪，你們都要拍掌！要用誇勝的聲音向神呼喊！
How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
For the Lord Most High is to be feared; he is a great King over all the earth.
因為耶和華至高者是可畏的；他是治理全地的大君王。
He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
He will put down the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.
他叫萬民服在我們以下，又叫列邦服在我們腳下。
He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah
He will give us our heritage, the glory of Jacob who is dear to him. (Selah.)
他為我們選擇產業，就是他所愛之雅各的榮耀。（細拉）
God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
God has gone up with a glad cry, the Lord with the sound of the horn.
神上升，有喊聲相送；耶和華上升，有角聲相送。
Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
Give praises to God, make songs of praise; give praises to our King, make songs of praise.
你們要向神歌頌，歌頌！向我們王歌頌，歌頌！
For God is King of all the earth; sing profound praises to Him.
For God is the King of all the earth; make songs of praise with knowledge.
因為神是全地的王；你們要用悟性歌頌。
God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
God is the ruler over the nations; God is on the high seat of his holy rule.
神作王治理萬國；神坐在他的聖寶座上。
The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
The rulers of the peoples have come together, with the people of the God of Abraham; because the powers of the earth are God's: he is lifted up on high.
列邦的君王聚集要作亞伯拉罕之神的民。因為世界的盾牌是屬神的；他為至高！
